notes.title: Forestry 2017 - The Simulation Build 1414 (Update 2)
notes.content:
Changelog:

Added fast travel via menu
Added key overview layer on main game screen
Added render distance in options menu
Added possibility to drag a tree with the tractor
Improved occlusion effects
Improved water effects
Improved vehicle physics
Improved user interface
Improved balancing
Various bugfixes
Minor localization fixes
